components.name: Contact Button
components.description: White primary action inside the contact modal.
components.css: .ds-contact-button { background: #fff; color: #000; border: 0; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font: 700 0.875rem Schibsted Grotesk, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity .2s ease; } .ds-contact-button:hover { opacity: .82; } .ds-contact-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Muted compact navigation that brightens on interaction.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { color: #b8b8b8; font: 600 .8125rem Schibsted Grotesk, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { color: #fff; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Project Entry
components.description: Flat content row separated by a fine rule.
components.css: .ds-project-entry { border-top: 1px solid #292929; padding: 1.8rem 0 2.25rem; color: #fff; font-family: Schibsted Grotesk, sans-serif; } .ds-project-entry h3 { margin: 0 0 1rem; font-size: 1.4rem; letter-spacing: -.025em; } .ds-project-entry p { margin: 0; color: #b9b9b9; font-size: .9375rem; line-height: 1.65; }

narrative.overview: An open, dark canvas lets the work, experience, and typography carry the page. The voice is direct and precise. Small motion cues add life to the interface while keeping the content easy to scan.

rules.name: The Monochrome Rule
rules.body: Keep the black, white, and gray palette as the dominant visual language.

rules.name: The Scan Rule
rules.body: Titles, dates, and descriptions should be readable as distinct levels without decorative type treatments.

dos: Do keep content hierarchy clear with spacing, typography, and fine rules.
Do keep interactions brief and respect reduced motion.
donts: Don't add decorative color that competes with the portfolio content.
Don't turn portfolio entries into heavy raised cards.
